measurement_scope.node_child_elapsed_ms: Each node's child spawn-to-independent OS wait interval; local node clock, not global cross-host makespan.
measurement_scope.controller_full_observation_ms: Controller-side launch through terminal status observation; distinct from per-node child elapsed.
measurement_scope.all_step_total_seconds: Sum of measured training iteration wall durations from the training log; measured_iterations is retained alongside it.
measurement_scope.node_cpu_seconds: Per-node user+system CPU seconds from the child-job rusage record; accumulated CPU, not latency.
measurement_scope.node_max_child_process_rss_MiB: Per-node child-process RSS high-water in MiB from children_maxrss_highwater_KiB; not whole-node memory.
measurement_scope.gpu_shared_card_metrics: Unavailable in this measurement schema; not inferred or filled.

interpretation_limits: All planned cases remain in the denominator, including missing, skipped, invalid, timed out, telemetry-failed, and triggered cases.
Natural PROFILE-triggered online cases are reported operationally and excluded from pure MONITOR cost comparisons.
External activity is retained as observed context; no noise is subtracted and no causal attribution is made.
Both OFF endpoints and their order drift are shown. Their equal-weight mean is descriptive, not a noise-corrected baseline.
Candidate-vs-original and candidate-vs-OFF figures are point estimates for this block only; 1% and 0.1% are targets, not population or zero-overhead claims.
MONITOR transport candidates are not judged equivalent by this report; this script only summarizes measurements and outcomes.
